title: Mahershala Ali Reveals the 1 Day He Says He Hates on Every Acting Job
metaDescription: Mahershala Ali opens up about the one part of filmmaking he still dreads, even after two Academy Awards.
altText: Mahershala Ali at a red carpet event wearing a white suit
html:
Mahershala Ali says he hates the first day of every acting job, even after winning two Academy Awards. He says he dislikes how he sounds and struggles to believe his own performance before a character settles into his body and voice.

A Familiar Anxiety, Every Single Time
